description: This file defines a data class `CartErrorEvent` used to represent transient cart error events within the UI layer of an online shopping platform. It includes an error message and an operation type indicating the context in which the error occurred.

classes.name: CartErrorEvent
classes.description: A data class representing a transient error event related to shopping cart operations, intended for UI consumption.

methods.description: Returns all the enum constants of the Operation enum.
